name: text-reveal-card
title: Text Reveal Card
description: A dark card shows a faint sentence that a second, brighter message replaces wherever your pointer has crossed. A thin divider bar rides the cursor edge, and the reveal snaps back when you leave.
use: You want a small surprising reward for moving the cursor over a card of copy.
avoid: Touch or keyboard readers need the hidden line, or the card must fit a narrow column.
a11y: The hidden line can only be uncovered by pointer or touch, with no keyboard route, and the star drift ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark grey card with a thin border holds a small white heading and a grey hint line at the top. Across its lower half a large bold sentence sits dim grey among drifting white specks; up to the pointer the same line appears bright white behind a narrow vertical bar.
behaves: Sliding the pointer across the card uncovers a bright copy of the sentence from the left, tracking the cursor with no lag, while a thin divider bar tilts and follows. Leaving the card retracts the reveal to nothing and fades the bar out.
customise: text and revealText set the two sentences, and children fill the header. The fixed forty-rem width, colours and the star field need a source edit.
weight: moderate: Eighty drifting star dots plus a pointer-tracked clip-path reveal.
